title: Restore independently reauthorized Case Queue return context over native HTTP
goal: Expose the already-existing RestoreCaseQueue as a bounded host-authenticated HTTP POST response for the exact originating Case Queue, without sending navigation state through GET query strings or trusting decoded tokens as authority.
invariants: Never treat a base64 token as a credential or trusted tenant/environment/Case selector. Current authenticated host session determines scope and owner provider data.
Every candidate Case and nested Incident/Finding is independently reauthorized server-side before RestoreCaseQueue reprojects currently visible selected Case and filters.
Return token travels in POST JSON body, not GET URL or logs. Unknown, malformed, excessive, duplicate JSON or query parameters are rejected before session/provider.
Restore is read-only; no Case mutation, new provider, IAM, Saved View persistence, storage, external dependency or paid API.
security_properties: Host-supplied current session/tenant/environment and read authorizer guard all Case and nested resources before applying untrusted ReturnState.
POST must be to the exact /case-queue/return route with bounded JSON token body and no query or new authorization fields; URL use of token forbidden.
Stale, denied, filtered Case, changed tenant/environment and invalid token return generic error with no partial queue or source metadata.
No-store/no-referrer, Vary Authorization, JSON response cap and no token leaks preserved.

migration.rationale: Read-only navigation response only; no migration, IAM or storage change.

rollback.strategy: Revert POST return handling; existing authorized GET Queue projection/handoff and Go helper RestoreCaseQueue remain intact.
verification: No Change to Case mutation or Saved View persistence
GET and original handoff tests green

inputs: Frozen PR #141 native GET Case Queue -> Workspace handoff on dcabc46620e06e0452a0e5d9c6827b4aff2a006c, exact-head engineering-kernel 39257205407 SUCCESS; L2 and merge still pending.
Existing first-party RestoreCaseQueue from E10-INV-101D-HANDOFF is VERIFIED; CAP-INV-101 §25 explicitly requires restoring selected Case, view, filters and scroll with reauthorization.
outputs: POST /case-queue/return accepts bounded JSON return_token in body, re-checks current host session and independent Case/Incident/Finding source ACL, invokes existing RestoreCaseQueue, returns only reauthorized ReturnState.
GET Case Queue listing and open_case remain unchanged; restore returns no Case payload and no permission grant.
acceptance_tests: Open Case from filtered/sorted native GET; POST returned token through /case-queue/return with the SAME authenticated principal and Case owner; restored selected Case, q, filters, sort, scroll.
Change ACL, Case staleness or tenant/environment before POST; deny with generic response and zero selected Case metadata.
Missing/invalid/oversize/malformed/double JSON keys, query token, wrong path, GET return and mismatched methods rejected before sessions/provider.
Existing GET projection/handoff unchanged; exact HEAD mandatory engineering-kernel security CI success, independent read-only L2 and approval still required.

performance_budget.rationale: Reuse existing <=5000 authorized Case candidate pass and RestoreCaseQueue re-projection once for one selected Case; no additional network/provider fetching.

No second provider read; only bounded first-party Case Queue projection
